description: This file defines the 'Log' utility class for logging purposes in an Android project. It provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for a list (or tree) of LoggerNodes. Provides static methods to log messages at various levels and manage log nodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode data will be sent to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Instructs the LogNode to print the log data provided.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Prints a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Prints a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Prints a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Prints a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Prints a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Prints a message at ASSERT priority.
